'''Sul Fansord''' was a [[human]] who served as a member of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. In [[1 BBY]], they were part of the Partisan forces that [[Battle on Jedha|ambushed]] an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank]] carrying [[kyber crystal]]s through [[Tythoni Square]] in [[Jedha City]], signaling the other Partisans when the vehicle arrived at an inflection point. They and two others then emerged in front of the [[TX-225 Occupier|tank]] and opened fire on the Imperials.

==Biography==
The [[human]] Sul Fansord was a member of the [[Partisans]], a group of freedom fighters led by the [[Onderonian]] [[Saw Gerrera]] who had established themselves in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] in order to disrupt the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[kyber crystal]] [[mining]] operations on the moon.<ref name="Battles" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> the Partisans planned to [[Battle on Jedha|ambush]] an Imperial [[convoy]] carrying a shipment of kyber [[crystal]]s in [[Jedha City]]'s [[Tythoni Square]]. Prior to the attack, the Partisans hid themselves around the square, with Fansord waiting on top of one of the archways leading into the square<ref name="RO" /> as a lookout.<ref name="Battles" />

[[File:FansordAttack-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Sul Fansord was part of the Partisan ambush in Tythoni Square.]]
After the convoy,<ref name="RO" /> which consisted of members of the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>—including several [[stormtrooper]]s on [[Limb|foot]] and a [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank]]—entered the square,<ref name="RO" /> Fansord signaled the other Partisans on a [[comlink]] when the [[TX-225 Occupier|tank]] reached an inflection point.<ref name="Battles" /> As the other Partisans prepared to attack, Fansord moved down to ground level and met up with two other human Partisans. When one of the other two gave the signal, the trio started walking out into the square as another Partisan who was stood on a balcony above the square hurled a [[grenade]] down in front of the [[tank]].<ref name="RO" />

After the grenade detonated, Fansord and the two Partisans with them revealed the [[blaster rifle]]s they had hidden under their [[Clothing|coats]] and opened fire on the Imperials while blocking one of the entry points into the square. The trio managed to gun down three stormtroopers in front of them, although one of Fansord's companions was then [[Death|killed]] by return fire. Ultimately, the Partisans managed to disable the tank and kill its escort, allowing them to steal the kyber crystals on board before Imperial reinforcements arrived. The [[city]] and the catacombs were [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] shortly afterwards by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]],<ref name="RO" /> killing many of the Partisans.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Sul Fansord had light skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. When signaling the other Partisans, they spoke in an [[alien]] [[language]].<ref name="RO" />

==Equipment==
Fansord wore a dark brown robe with a light brown coat over it that had red cuffs. They also wore dark red hood, a brown [[backpack]] with gray straps, and black [[boot]]s. During the ambush, they used a silver comlink and a black [[blaster]] rifle.<ref name="RO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sul Fansord appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', portrayed by an uncredited actor.<ref name="RO" /> The character was later identified in the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="Battles" />
